row.team_price_text: Mend AppSec: up to $1000 per dev/year (demo/quote)
row.evidence: Mend's SSO docs offer to "automatically create users during the first SSO login" and its Entra tutorial says "Mend.io supports Just In Time user provisioning"; no SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere in the Mend docs index.
row.notes: WhiteSource rebranded to Mend.io (legacy API host api-app.whitesourcesoftware.com still listed). Pricing page shows only per-product ceilings (Mend AppSec up to $1000, Mend AI up to $300, Renovate Enterprise up to $250 per contributing developer per year) behind 'Get a demo', so no per-user price is recorded. No SCIM: user automation is SAML JIT plus SAML group/role mapping; user lifecycle can be scripted through the Mend API 3.0 (invite, block/unblock, remove users; manage groups and group roles), which any Mend user can call with their user key. Plan that includes SAML is not stated publicly. Okta setup uses a custom SAML app (no OIN listing found).

plans.name: Mend AppSec
plans.notes: Ceiling price on the pricing page; sold via demo/quote. SAML SSO is documented for the Mend Platform but no plan is named.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the Mend docs index (docs.mend.io/llms.txt, ~1,200 pages) or API reference; provisioning is JIT on SAML sign-in.

roles.how: SAML group mapping (IdP groups replicated and auto-created in Mend) or role mapping via a SAML group attribute; not SCIM

auth.notes: Login with email, org UUID and user key returns a refresh token; the Refresh Access Token call returns a JWT that expires every 30 minutes.

endpoints.purpose: Remove a user from an organization
Remove a user from a group

limitations.text: Group-to-role assignment is not automated in-product; Mend says it must be scripted with the API.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'whitesource' returns nothing and a search for 'mend' lists only Mendeley, Mendix and Unbxd; Mend's Okta guide has admins create a custom SAML 2.0 app.

entra.notes: Gallery app supports SAML SSO with JIT provisioning only.

jumpcloud.notes: No Mend/WhiteSource entry in JumpCloud's integrations or support sitemaps; no citable page.

fallbacks.other_sync: SAML group and role mapping on sign-in

citations.title: SAML Group and Role Mapping
citations.quote: By default, users who login to Mend via SSO are assigned to the "users" group. If you'd like to automatically assign users to additional groups (for example: product or org admin) you can configure group or role mapping.
